segments.text: I spent a whole year saying flats in my city were too expensive. The truth was simpler.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker spent a year complaining about high apartment prices, but the real issue was simpler.

segments.turkishExplanation: İlk başta yeterli gelmedi ama küçük miktarlar birikerek çoğalır.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To use up all of something so that none is left.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I ran out of money before the end of the month.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To keep or save something, such as money, for a specific purpose.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Belli bir amaç için para veya zaman ayırmak, kenara koymak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: She sets aside a portion of her income every month.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Her ay gelirinin bir kısmını kenara ayırıyor.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To accumulate or build up gradually into a larger total.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Zamanla birikerek büyük bir toplama ulaşmak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Small daily expenses can quickly add up.
